tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Scores how well AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) can find, read and understand a website. Runs 30 checks in five groups: AI crawler access, what the homepage tells machines, structured data, entity and authority (Wikidata, Wikipedia, linked profiles) and AI-ready

tools.name: check_ai_crawlers
tools.description: Shows which of 20 AI crawlers can read a website's homepage: AI search and answer bots (OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot, Bingbot and more) and AI training bots (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot and more).
